title: Understanding Feature Selection with L1 Regularization
text: L1 regularization, also known as Lasso, tends to select only one feature when two features are highly correlated. This is because it adds a penalty equal to the absolute value of the magnitude of coefficients, encouraging sparsity.

title: Impact of Feature Scale on L1 Regularization
text: When features are on different scales, L1 regularization tends to select the feature with the larger scale. This is because the penalty term is applied equally to all coefficients, making it easier to shrink smaller coefficients to zero.
